native_backend.physics: MuJoCo-Warp CUDA, not CPU MuJoCo or PhysX
native_backend.contact_forces: mjwarp.contact_force world-frame, signed net sum by original body
native_backend.performance_caveat: CUDA Graph availability remains determined by the pinned mjlab/driver
native_backend.contact_reduction: fixed-capacity Warp kernel, no Torch boolean indexing
native_backend.stream_handoff: bidirectional CUDA events; no host stream synchronization
native_backend.physics_semantics: unchanged step+full-forward pairing, 8 pairs per control interval

environment.state_continuity: No cold reset between control intervals; reset only on episode boundaries
environment.critic_order: policy_layout51 (unbiased leg positions for mjlab_v1p4), robot_body_pos_b27, nonwheel_body_ori_b42

reward_contract.sideslip_target: held reference body-frame course angle, NOT zero
reward_contract.reference_order: Freeze reference[k] and relative-body targets at pre-action state; evaluate after decimation, before command advances.
reward_contract.pose_semantics: World link-origin position and link wxyz quaternion
reward_contract.velocity_semantics: World original-unmerged-link COM linear velocity and world angular velocity
reward_contract.cost: dt * (sum_positive_reward_weights - sum(weight * raw_term)); no terminal term supplied
surrogate_differences: MuJoCo net contact forces are not identical to PhysX ContactSensor forces; all contacts, including self-contact, are included.
undesired_contacts uses max norm over supplied physical-substep history; omitted history is explicitly an instantaneous surrogate.
MuJoCo-derived 0.95 joint ranges are an approximation unless replaced by Isaac runtime soft_joint_pos_limits in matching joint order.
Body COM offsets/inertias must match the original unmerged USD links; random COM offsets require the same realized model parameters.
Task tilt safety termination and policy action/observation privileges are outside this stage objective.
reward_contract.nonfinite_policy: Raise; never silently replace invalid samples with finite scores

environment.motion_end_timeout: held reference phase >= last frame, checked before phase advance
environment.terminal_observation: postphysics, held command, before autoreset; diagnostic only, official RSL timeout bootstrap is unchanged

dr.encoder_bias_semantics: observation +b, position target -b; wheel angles not observed
dr.friction_scope: two colliding wheel geoms, shared per environment
dr.push_timer_correction: resample on all episode resets, including function-based interval event
dr.restitution: MuJoCo existing solver-default contact law; no restitution-coefficient equivalence claimed
dr.material_combine: MuJoCo geom/pair priority/friction rules; NOT PhysX arithmetic average

environment.random_stream: private per-device Torch generator; startup draws unchanged, subsequent distributions unchanged but not NumPy draw-for-draw
environment.task_event_host_transfer: one 3-byte reset/push/fault payload per interval; no bulk tensors
environment.physics_forward_schedule: unchanged pairing: 8 step + 8 forward, conditional reset and push forwards

limitations: Surviving the full clip is not by itself evidence of a successful jump.
All environments begin from the same reference frame0 state without random perturbations; this is a deterministic smoke evaluation, not a robustness success probability.
Reported height is the measured base_Link origin, not center-of-mass height, reference height, or wheel clearance.
Contact events use wheel net-force norms sampled at policy frequency; self-contact can also contribute to these net forces.
Flight needs at least 0.10s prior two-wheel support and 0.04s both-wheel contact absence; landing needs 0.10s subsequent two-wheel support.
jump_and_landing_detected additionally requires at least0.05m measured base height gain; it does not certify stable recovery or hardware feasibility.
Torque samples are the last physics substep, not the maximum over all decimation substeps.
qpos arrays use named Isaac joint order, not native MuJoCo joint order; MuJoCo deployment must remap by name.
Root linear velocity follows Isaac's COM-velocity convention; root pose is the link-frame pose.
The exported actor emits raw actions; deployment must clamp all8 actions to[-1,1] before the documented action scaling.

contact.reason: no qualifying flight after sustained two-wheel support was detected
contact.force_source: summed wheel-ground normal contact forces, excluding robot self-contact

contact_slip_measurement.point_source: MuJoCo data.contact.pos for wheel/world collision pairs only
contact_slip_measurement.velocity_source: mj_jacBodyCom at data.xipos; COM linear and angular velocity transported to each contact point
contact_slip_measurement.lateral_axis: body local +Y wheel axle projected into each actual contact tangent plane
contact_slip_measurement.aggregation: normal-force-weighted RMS over active contact points per wheel
contact_slip_measurement.no_contact: count=0 and slip=0; slip requires positive contact count for interpretation
contact_slip_measurement.ground_force_kind: sum of normal contact forces, matching the filtered PhysX contact API

report.nonwheel_ground_contact_force_kind: sum of actual wheel-excluded ground contact normal forces; point count uses normal force >1N
limitations: One deterministic sim2sim episode, not a robustness or real-hardware validation.
Contact solver/cylinder approximations and self-collision parent filtering remain engine-specific.
DC no-load speed defines a torque-speed envelope, not a hard qvel limit; external forces can exceed it.
DC motor parameters are simulation assumptions, not validated manufacturer ratings. The DC model changes training physics.
MuJoCo contact forces are instantaneous constraint forces; Isaac contact sensors may aggregate differently.
Lateral contact slip uses real contact points sampled at 400 Hz; contact patch resolution remains engine-specific.
Reference is held for each 20 ms action; training termination predicates are checked before phase advances.
